title: MEG-SCANS - A comprehensive magnetoencephalography speech dataset with Stories, Chirps And Noisy Sentences.
description: MEG-SCANS is a magnetoencephalography (MEG) dataset comprising raw and MaxFiltered recordings from 24 German-speaking participants performing an auditory speech experiment. Stimuli included audiobooks, Oldenburger Matrix Sentence Test sentences at varying intelligibility levels for speech reception threshold assessment, and chirp stimuli for signal quality checks. The dataset also includes structural MRI scans, hearing screening results, empty-room recordings, and audio stimulus materials, organized in BIDS format to support encoding/decoding analyses of speech-evoked brain responses.
methods_description: MEG data were recorded from 24 German-speaking participants during an approximately one-hour auditory experiment involving audiobooks, OLSA sentences at varying speech intelligibility levels, and chirp stimuli. Data collection included raw and MaxFiltered MEG recordings, pre- and post-session empty-room MEG recordings, structural MRI scans, and behavioral audiogram/SRT results. Auxiliary MISC channels captured audio and instructor microphone signals at 1000 Hz.
